==Biography==
Nihat "'''Innaxe'''" Aliev was born in Borino, Bulgaria, and lives in London, United Kingdom. He started playing ''League of Legends'' in Season 1, returning to the game to climb the ranked ladder in Season 3 after two years away from the game playing ''World of Warcraft''.

===League of Legends Career===
Innaxe's first team was [[Newcastle Jaguars]], and has since played for a number of teams in the UK scene - [[Sensei UK]], [[Team XENEX]], and [[exceL eSports]]. In January 2018 he was named as a substitute for [[Splyce]] and on the starting roster of [[KIYF eSports Club]].

== Trivia ==
* His ID comes from Romanian singer ''[[wikipedia:en:Inna|Inna]]'' plus "axe" - a name he first used while playing ''WoW''.
* Enjoys producing his own music in his free time, and was offered related work in Istanbul, Turkey.
* Is a huge fan of EDM, wants to go ''[[wikipedia:en:Tomorrowland (festival)|Tomorrowland]]'' and ''[[wikipedia:en:Ultra Music Festival|Ultra]]'' in the future.
* Is one of only three Bulgarians to attend [[Worlds]], alongside [[BloodWater]] and [[Hylissang]].
* Had a 100 percent winrate on {{ci|Heimerdinger}} at [[Worlds 2019]].
